formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p18_t2_corrected_midpoint_order_bound {n : Nat} (h epsilon : Real) (scheme perturbation : Fin n -> Real) : p18VecNorm2 (p18CorrectedMidpointError h epsilon scheme perturbation) <= h^2 * (p18VecNorm2 scheme + abs epsilon * p18VecNorm2 perturbation)
formal_statement.plain_language: The corrected midpoint error represented by a second-order scheme term and a second-order precision term has the exact expected second-order norm envelope.

informal_proof: Use the vector triangle inequality, use homogeneity of the Euclidean norm on each scaled component, and factor out h squared.
informal_statement: An exact finite-vector version of the corrected implicit midpoint estimate O(Δt²) + O(ε Δt²).
